clips.title: The story
paras: At Mystral Lake, befouled water spirits have halted Horde supply transports on the way to Stonetalon. Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post sends you to clear the hostile elementals and scout a night elf gazebo overlooking Silverwind Refuge.

The Horde needs lumber, supplies, and messengers to travel between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The Talondeep Path carries them past Mystral Lake’s western shore. Hostile water elementals have stopped travel and battered the supply caravans. Mastok Wrilehiss calls for action to reopen the route before the Horde’s supply lines collapse.

Water elementals in Mystral Lake have become befouled, aggressive, and unpredictable. They attack those who take the nearby trails. You are sent to cull them and defeat the greater spirit Tideress so the area may become safer. What has tainted the lake’s spirits remains unknown amid the turmoil in Ashenvale’s sacred groves.

A night elf gazebo stands on Mystral Lake’s central island, with a clear view across the water to Silverwind Refuge. Horde scouts are sent to assess whether it could serve as a forward observation post. From there, Splintertree’s commanders could watch nearby Alliance movements without being detected.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... Which means anyone on the path. What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...
Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.
